findings.text: follow-on: the default gate-log selection takes test_logs[0] without identifying the head arm, so a manifest that lists the base arm's log first would default the base log and its EXIT status as the promotion's gate_check evidence; the reviewed run's own manifest lists head-arm.log first so it is unaffected, but the default is positional where the field's meaning is not.

follow-on: the base arm's command header reads "pytest ... -q <40 importing files>", an angle-bracket placeholder rather than the literal command the done-when requires, so the base arm's gate cannot be re-executed from its own log.

follow-on: the manifest carries the two suites as free text under tests/test_logs rather than the armed baseline_suite/after_suite JSON fields, so a reader cannot machine-derive the added-failure count from the manifest and must re-derive it from the raw arm logs as this review did.
